description: Purchase APIHub credits via x402 (USDC on Base). Returns payment instructions including a web URL for browser-based payment, a CLI command, and raw x402 requirements for agents with wallet support. Credits are added to your account instantly once payment confirms on-chain.

amount_dollars.description: Amount to top up in USD. Minimum $5.00, maximum $10,000 per call. Example: 10 for $10.

name: apihub_topup
